'''Gelleric''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] made his notes in the [[Book of Sith]], he reflected that since Gelleric was the only [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] whom he could think of who wielded a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], it was possible that it was indeed a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] weapon.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gelleric's name is a [[tuckerization]] of Eric Geller, friend of author [[Daniel Wallace]] and a former staff member at ''Star Wars'' news site [[TheForce.net]].<ref name="geekosity">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_30.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 3)|date=2012-03-30|quote=That name, "Master Gelleric," is a nod to TheForce.net's Eric Geller.}}</ref>
